figurative_meaning_en: Stern rebuke or reprimand accompanied by loud denunciation
example_sentences_in_bangla: ম্যানেজারের তর্জনগর্জন শুনে সবাই চুপ করে গেল।
পিতা ছেলেকে তর্জনগর্জন করে শাসন করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone fell silent after hearing the manager's thunderous scolding.
The father reprimanded his son with a stern roar.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of authoritative figures using loud, intimidating voices, common in Bengali literary expressions.
